events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hello, My name is Theo Lindquist. Date of birth, 11/02/1979. Send a refill for my metformin but make it one thousand milligrams. I've been taking two a day.
One moment while I check your details.
I sent your dose change question to the prescribing team, reference Q N, two seven six four. A clinician will answer, and your prescription record has not been changed.
Fine. Send the request for the dose on my record and ask the doctor about the higher dose.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, metformin five hundred milligram tablets, one tablet twice a day with meals, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Right, I'll send that request for review.
Your refill request for the dose on your record is reference R Q, five three three eight. It is awaiting prescribing team review, and the higher dose question is already with them.
